purpose: Cue verbs are deliberately allowed here; the variable under test is endpoint alignment: appositions, descriptors, head-token matches, relative clauses, coordination splitting. Alignment must resolve to the promoted named entity, and must never mint a new entity because resolution failed.

items.evidence: Quartzline's archival store, Vaultstone, consumes the Nightly Snapshot Feed.

must_not.notes: apposition: subject endpoint is Vaultstone, not the descriptor

items.evidence: One service, the Pinion API, uses the Falcon Cache.
The Redlark database supports the Glowline Metrics dashboard.

must_not.notes: head/contained match: 'The Redlark database' -> Redlark; 'the Glowline Metrics dashboard' -> Glowline Metrics. Node names must be the promoted entities, not the full NPs.

items.evidence: The Falcon Cache layer depends on the Sable Index.
Vaultstone, which Quartzline owns, exposes a retrieval endpoint.

must_not.notes: relative clause: owns comes from 'which Quartzline owns'; direction Quartzline->Vaultstone

items.evidence: A component called Trellis is part of the Pinion API.

must_not.notes: the Meridian Resolver failure class: named entity inside a DESCRIPTION NP must become the endpoint

items.evidence: The Glowline Metrics dashboard, a Quartzline product, depends on the Redlark database.

must_not.notes: apposition on the subject side must not shift the endpoint

items.evidence: The Pinion API produces the Audit Summary Report and sends rollups to Redlark.

must_not.notes: coordination: the object must be 'Audit Summary Report', never 'the Audit Summary Report and sends rollups to Redlark' (the Meridian Graph Writer failure class)

items.evidence: The Pinion API produces the Audit Summary Report and sends rollups to Redlark.

must_not.notes: the second conjunct must become its own proposition

items.evidence: The archival store retains snapshots for seven years.

must_not.notes: unresolved generic NP: acceptable outcomes are UNRESOLVED or a coreference to Vaultstone; minting 'archival store' as a new entity is a failure

items.evidence: An onboarding document claimed that Trellis is part of Redlark; the diagram was fixed in review.
The Sable Index is depended on by the Falcon Cache layer during warm starts.

must_not.notes: passive + descriptor: direction must match A04, endpoint must be Falcon Cache

invariants: no endpoint minted from an NP that failed alignment
every canonical edge's node names equal promoted entity names (no descriptor prefixes/suffixes)
A08 and A09 are two distinct edges, not one glommed object
